status: Eight canonical thematic wheels: Holy/Blood/Cosmic/Symbiote twelve each; Divine/Cursed/Demonic/Angelic twenty each. 93 local definitions plus shared canonical Flight; 128 wheel slots, equal base weights; detailed limits pending.

contract.scope: One canonical wheel for each theme, shared by all races, characters, archetypes, events, and other approved callers. Do not combine all themes into one mega-pool.
contract.grant: Only the selected one power; no bundle of lower-ranked options.
contract.caller: Caller guard determines access only. Record real source family, subtype, stage, sourceSpinId, componentSlot, and return continuation; selecting a power does not change race.
contract.odds: A canonical theme uses the same definitions and base weights for every caller. Only declared approved modifiers may alter conditional odds; no caller-specific copy.
contract.mastery: Early grants remain owned and unresolved until main Power Mastery. None removes no earlier grant; power mastery never creates enchantment.
contract.rank: Relative potential is not mastery, rarity, main stats, or Apex Force.
contract.sourceAuthority: Power descriptions are authored game capacities, not franchise packages or scientific claims.
contract.registry: Race design imports each wheel by canonical ID. Definitions and outcomes exist only here; importing references are not duplicate active wheels.
contract.weights: Equal base weight 1: twenty-outcome themes each 5% per outcome, four outcomes per tier (20% per tier). Other twelve-outcome themes each 1/12. Only explicit approved modifiers change conditional odds; tier ordering adds no rarity.
contract.symbioteDraws: power-symbiote grants one selected power per invocation. Symbiote 80/90% schedules one invocation, 100% schedules two sequential invocations, each with its own actual spin, grant, reaction and source ordinal. Takeover stat stacking is governed by the separate Symbiote event contract.
contract.divineDraws: One power per actual invocation. God two Divine; Pemuka Agama one Divine; Apostle God one Divine. Angel two Angelic; Priest/Bishop/Fallen Angel one Angelic each. Ordinary common mastery; God maximum remains actual Concept Authority only. Paladin ordinary one Angelic; Nirvana High Paladin three Angelic, sequential actual invocations.

demonicAccess.status: Canonical independent Demonic wheel, user-requested; former Cursed display-alias interpretation retired.
demonicAccess.policy: One selected power per actual sequential invocation; same canonical pool/base weights, true source provenance, no None or uniqueness reroll.

cursedArchetypeAccess.policy: Additional caller only; existing Cursed race callers/pool/powers/tiers stay unchanged. Selected package schedules sequential actual calls and then source-owned Cursed Weakness children.

vesselAccess.policy: Canonical thematic calls retain ordinary scope/tiers; God60–80 invokes one shared Concept Authority instead of Divine. True Vessel provenance, no race copy or uniqueness reroll.

migrationContract.effectiveFor: New invocations freeze catalogVersion universal-power/0.2.0. Do not reinterpret committed outcomes against a latest pool.
migrationContract.preserve: All 63 earlier local power definitions and their tier ratings remain byte-equivalent JSON objects. Holy/Blood/Cosmic/Symbiote wheels stay unchanged. Existing journals retain original pools, odds, routes and grants.
migrationContract.aliases: Historical Elf-prefixed wheel IDs keep their canonical target. Former Demonic->Cursed display alias is retired, never an active mapping for new Demonic callers.
migrationContract.membershipChanges: Devil Avatar and Infernal Sovereignty remain the same canonical definitions and move from new Cursed membership to Demonic. Common powers may occur in several themes by reference only.
